items.title: Trump Amps Up Pressure on Billionaire Sargeant to Exit Venezuela
items.author: Patricia Garip
items.content: <article>The Trump administration is dialing up pressure on Florida oil magnate and Republican Party donor Harry Sargeant III to divest from Venezuela.</article>

items.title: Trump Envoys Witkoff, Kushner May Visit Kyiv, Moscow Next Week, Tass Says
items.author: Bloomberg News
items.content: <article>Key members of President Donald Trump’s foreign policy team — special envoy Steve Witkoff and son-in-law Jared Kushner — may visit Kyiv and Moscow within the next seven to 10 days, Russian state-run Tass news agency reported, citing an official who wasn’t identified.</article>

items.title: Vance Says US in ‘Middle of the Game’ in Iran Conflict
items.author: Sam Kim
items.content: <article>“We’re in the middle of the game,” in the situation over Iran, Vice President JD Vance says in an interview that aired Saturday on Fox News.</article>

items.title: Drones Sighted Over German Military Base After Airport Incident
items.author: Christina Kyriasoglou
items.content: <article>Two drones were sighted flying over a key military base in western Germany late on Thursday, just days after an armed unmanned aircraft was discovered at a major cargo hub in the country’s east.</article>

items.title: Iran Says Hormuz Deal Close But Its Conditions Must Be Met
items.author: Patrick Sykes, Sara Gharaibeh and Cam Kettles
items.content: <article>Iran said it’s “very close” to a deal with Oman on a new maritime transit route in the Strait of Hormuz, after expectations grew this week that an announcement may soon be made.</article>

items.title: Senate Confirms Former Trump Defense Lawyer as AG
items.content: <article>The Senate confirmed Todd Blanche as Attorney General despite initial opposition from multiple senators concerned about Blanche's ties to President Trump. A deal was struck in the early hours to secure enough votes with key holdouts such as Senator Bill Cassidy changing his position. Bloomberg News Washington Deputy Bureau Chief Laura Davison joins David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss the tense and closely watched process. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Bulgaria Says Drone Crashes Near Gas Pipeline After Entering From Romania
items.author: Slav Okov
items.content: <article>The drone that crashed into a sunflower field in Bulgaria early Saturday was most likely a model commonly used by Ukraine, the Bulgarian defense ministry said.</article>

items.title: Magyar’s Party Names Former Chief Justice for Hungary President
items.author: Andras Gergely and Thomas Escritt
items.content: <article>Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar’s party named former Supreme Court justice Andras Baka as its new candidate to assume the office of president following last month’s ouster of Tamas Sulyok.</article>

items.title: Turkey Delays Black Sea Ship Access After Surge in Attacks
items.author: Patrick Sykes and Weilun Soon
items.content: <article>Turkey is restricting some commercial ship traffic into the Black Sea, according to people familiar with the matter, following growing concern from the government over an uptick in Russian and Ukrainian attacks on vessels in the area.</article>

items.title: Todd Blanche Confirmed by Senate as Trump’s Attorney General
items.author: Steven T. Dennis and Aidan Williams
items.content: <article>The US Senate confirmed Todd Blanche as attorney general, elevating President Donald Trump’s one-time personal defense lawyer to lead the nation’s top federal law enforcement agency.</article>

items.title: Senate Passes Funding Bill That Ignores Trump’s Priorities
items.author: Erik Wasson
items.content: <article>The US Senate passed a short-term spending bill to avert a damaging government shutdown weeks before the November midterms, sidestepping President Donald Trump’s calls to also enact emergency funds for the Iran war and elements of a controversial voter identification proposal.</article>

items.title: US Says Ukraine to Avoid Targeting Tankers, Oil Site
items.author: Jennifer A. Dlouhy and Alex Longley
items.content: <article>Ukraine has agreed not to target some non-Russian oil tankers and Black Sea infrastructure critical for exporting Kazakhstan’s crude after strikes on vessels last month halted loadings, according to a US official.</article>

items.title: Senate Delays Clarity Act Vote Until After August Recess | Balance of Power: Late Edition 08/07/2026
items.content: <article>"Balance of Power: Late Edition" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Senator Chris Coons of Delaware discussed the current Senate agenda, aiming to pass a government funding bill to avoid a shutdown through December, highlighting the importance for federal employees and the country's global standing. Republican Congressman Dusty Johnson of South Dakota, a member of the House Committee on Agriculture and the House Select Committee on China, spoke about the ongoing negotiations in the Senate regarding a continuing resolution to fund the government. Democratic Congressman Greg Landsman of Ohio, a member of the House Energy and Commerce Committee, discussed the recent Senate passage of the Lindsey Graham Russia sanctions bill.  (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Rep. Landsman on Senate Passes Bipartisan Russia Sanctions Bill
items.content:
<article>Democratic Congressman Greg Landsman of Ohio, a member of the House Energy and Commerce Committee, discussed the recent Senate passage of the Lindsey Graham Russia sanctions bill. The bill, which passed with a strong bipartisan vote of 86 to 11, would grant the president authority to impose tariffs on countries that purchase Russian oil. The legislation now moves to the House of Representatives, where Congressman Landsman was asked about his support and whether he expects the majority of his Democratic colleagues to back the measure. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power."
 (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Rep. Dusty Johnson: ’Shutdowns are Stupid’
items.content: <article>Republican Congressman Dusty Johnson of South Dakota, a member of the House Committee on Agriculture and the House Select Committee on China, spoke about the ongoing negotiations in the Senate regarding a continuing resolution to fund the government beyond the end of September. He noted that the House has already passed its version of the resolution and expressed cautious optimism that if the Senate returns the bill with only modest changes, the House would likely approve it quickly. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Sen. Coons: Think We Can Get Senate Votes Done
items.content:
<article>Senator Chris Coons of Delaware discussed the current Senate agenda, aiming to pass a government funding bill to avoid a shutdown through December, highlighting the importance for federal employees and the country's global standing. Coons noted the recent passage of the Lindsey Graham Russia sanctions act, which he supports as a measure to deter Russian aggression in Ukraine. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power."
 (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Colombia’s De la Espriella Takes Power, Vows Crime Crackdown
items.author: Patricia Laya
items.content: <article>Abelardo de la Espriella was sworn in as Colombia’s president Friday, marking the start of a conservative government that promises a sharp break with Gustavo Petro’s leftist administration as concerns over the nation’s finances and increased violence cloud the transition.</article>

items.title: Canada Races For Deal Before 50% Trump Tariff Inflames Feud
items.author: Brian Platt and Nojoud Al Mallees
items.content: <article>Canadian negotiators are trying to secure a deal with the US before 50% tariffs on a wide range of goods threatened by President Donald Trump kick in on Aug. 19, while warning of an ugly new phase of the trade dispute if the levies are imposed.</article>

items.title: Trump Touts $3 Billion in Minerals Projects to Counter China
items.author: Joe Deaux, Jeff Mason and Jacob Lorinc
items.content: <article>President Donald Trump touted $3 billion in US investments in critical minerals mining at a meeting Friday with top industry executives aimed at weaning the US off supply chains dominated by China.</article>

items.title: Congo Ebola Outbreak: Merck Ervebo Vaccine, Gilead Remdesivir Eyed for Wider Use
items.author: Janice Kew and Jason Gale
items.content: <article>Merck & Co.’s Ebola vaccine and an antiviral drug from Gilead Sciences Inc. are set for wider use in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo to blunt the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record.</article>
